facts.value: Primary emergency rescue, fire suppression, and search-and-rescue operations across Lebanon.
Emergency medical services (EMS) and pre-hospital patient transport.
First responder for structural collapses, building wall hazards, sinkhole emergencies, and flood rescues.
Emergency hotline: 125. Call immediately for any life-safety incident.
facts.notes: 125 confirmed by domain-expert eval dataset (SRC-022). Previous internal draft erroneously used 175 — 175 is NOT the correct Civil Defense number. VERIFIED: 125.

facts.value: Secondary/public inquiries: civildefense.gov.lb. Official complaints channel: complaints@civildefense.gov.lb and phone/fax 01 287125. Official X account: @CivilDefenseLB.
Operates nationwide through regional divisions. All Lebanese governorates covered.
Emergency dispatch target: immediate (within minutes of call). No published SLA, but operational standard is fastest possible response.
facts.notes: No official published SLA. CedarFix operational classification: 'immediate emergency'.

facts.value: For emergencies: call 125 directly. CedarFix must always trigger HITL when routing to Civil Defense and display number 125 prominently.
